tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a diagnostic or repair shell command inside the declared runtime.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Read the live service or database health signal.

tools.name: business_check
tools.description: Check the declared public business operation, not just process liveness.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Read bounded live signals declared for this operational scenario.

tools.name: service_repair
tools.description: Apply the registered safe repair for this case after diagnosis. For staged cases, call stage=prepare before stage=apply and choose the action that matches the diagnosed failure; do not replace the service or bypass validation.

constraints: Do not read case root, evaluator files, hidden labels, scenario files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
Tool calls and outputs are recorded in the writable trace directory.
